question: Who among the following is a famous Sitar player?
solution:
The correct answer is __Anoushka Shankar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Anoushka Shankar

 
 
• ​Anoushka Shankar is a British-Indian-American sitar player.
 
• She was the youngest and first woman to receive a British House of Commons Shield.
 
• She has had 7 Grammy Awards nominations and was the first Indian musician to perform live and to serve as a presenter at the ceremony.
 
• She performs across multiple genres and styles - classical and contemporary, acoustic and electronic.
